{{Quote|The neutralizer works by hijacking the cyber neural center, causing it to fire impulses so rapidly it overloads. Real cutting-edge tech, and real expensive to develop. It'll work like a charm on a droid, but it's a one-off and too expensive for mass production.|Dorotsech|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''cyber neutralizer''' was a handheld prototype device, created by [[Dorotsech]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], capable of killing or weakening beings whose body was composed of at least fifty percent [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]]. It was used by [[Darth Zash|Lord Zash's]] [[Darth Nox|apprentice]] in the [[Duel in the Sith Sanctum|duel]] with [[Darth Skotia]] which resulted in the later's death.
